name: DescribeEmgVulItem

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The risk status of the vulnerabilities to query. If this parameter is not specified, vulnerabilities of all risk statuses are returned, including those with risks and those without risks. Valid values:
y: at risk
n: not at risk
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的漏洞风险状态。  
如果不设置该参数的取值，会默认返回全部风险状态的漏洞（包括存在风险和无风险）。取值：
y：存在风险
n：无风险
parameters.name: risk_status

parameters.help_en:
The detection method of the vulnerabilities to query. If this parameter is not specified, vulnerabilities detected by all methods are returned by default, including version detection and network scanning. Valid values:
python: version detection (server software version detection). Detects whether your server has disclosed software vulnerabilities.
scan: network scanning (network traffic detection). Detects whether your public assets (Internet-accessible servers) have vulnerabilities
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的漏洞检测方式。  
如果不设置该参数的取值，会默认返回全部检测方式的漏洞（包括版本检测和网络扫描）。取值：
python：版本检测（服务器软件版本检测）。检测您的服务器是否存在已披露的软件漏洞。
scan：网络扫描（网络流量检测）。检测您的公网资产（即公网可访问的服务器）是否存在漏洞
parameters.name: scan_type

parameters.help_en:
The check type. Valid values:

0: POC verification
1: version comparison
parameters.help_zh:
检测方式。取值：

0：POC验证
1：版本比对
parameters.name: check_type

parameters.example: Changjietong T + SetupAccount/Upload.aspx file Upload vulnerability (CNVD-2022-60632)
parameters.help_en: The name of the emergency vulnerability to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的应急漏洞名称
parameters.name: vul_name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the first page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates that query results are displayed starting from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 emergency vulnerability entries are displayed per page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的应急漏洞信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条应急漏洞信息，最大取值50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource directory (Alibaba Cloud account).
Invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
CurrentPage.description_zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。起始值为1。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示

GroupedVulItems.description_en: The information about the emergency vulnerabilities
GroupedVulItems.description_zh: 查询到的应急漏洞信息

AliasName.example: Changjietong T + SetupAccount/Upload.aspx file Upload vulnerability (CNVD-2022-60632)

Description.example: Chanjet T-Plus is an Internet business management software. There is an unauthorized access vulnerability in one of its interfaces disclosed on the Internet. Attackers can construct malicious requests to upload malicious files to execute arbitrary code and control the server.

GmtLastCheck.description_en: The timestamp of the most recent vulnerability detection. Unit: milliseconds
GmtLastCheck.description_zh: 最近一次检测漏洞的时间戳，单位为毫秒

GmtPublish.description_en: The timestamp when the vulnerability was published. Unit: milliseconds
GmtPublish.description_zh: 漏洞发布时间戳，单位为毫秒

Name.description_en: The name of the scan rule

Progress.description_en:
The detection progress of the vulnerability. Value range: 0 to 100.
This parameter is displayed only for emergency vulnerabilities that are in the detecting state
Progress.description_zh:
漏洞检测进度。取值范围：0~100。
只有检测状态为检测中的应急漏洞会展示该参数

RaspDefend.description_en:
Indicates whether Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) real-time protection is supported. Valid values:
0: Not supported.
1: Supported.
If this property is not present, RASP real-time protection is not supported
RaspDefend.description_zh:
支持RASP实时防护，取值：
0：不支持
1：支持
无该属性也表示不支持

Status.description_en:
The detection status of the vulnerability. Valid values:
10: not detected
20: detecting
30: detection completed
Status.description_zh:
漏洞检测状态。取值：
10：未检测
20：检测中
30：已完成检测

Type.description_en:
The detection method of the vulnerability. Valid values:
python: version detection (server software version detection). Detects whether your server has disclosed software vulnerabilities.
scan: network scanning (network traffic detection). Detects whether your public assets (Internet-accessible servers) have vulnerabilities
Type.description_zh:
漏洞的检测方式。取值：
python：版本检测（服务器软件版本检测）。检测您的服务器是否存在已披露的软件漏洞。
scan：网络扫描（网络流量检测）。检测您的公网资产（即公网可访问的服务器）是否存在漏洞

PageSize.description_en: The number of emergency vulnerability entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 emergency vulnerability entries are displayed per page. Paging is used to display the results
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的应急漏洞信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条应急漏洞信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of emergency vulnerabilities returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的应急漏洞总数
